before.label: Closed corner sign panel
before.notes: Observed: blue brick infill with painted logo, no door leaf or handle. Preserve solid chamfered corner. Current plain blue brick is an unfinished material study.

after.label: Closed corner sign panel
after.notes: Observed solid blue-brick infill with a painted door symbol, not an opening. The chamfer remains solid and now carries the reusable graphic; weathered lintel/surround are approximations of the photographed surfaces.

before.label: Glazed street entrance
before.notes: Observed: separate glazed opening to the right of the blue door. Adopted customer entrance for the walkable study; use requires route validation.

after.label: Glazed stair entrance
after.notes: Observed glazed entrance to the right of the blue exhibition door. Architect plan identifies this as the stair entry, separate from the cafe entrance on the opposite facade. Two-leaf assembly and full-width canopy now exist; both leaves were independently opened and traversed in walkthrough16. Exact dimensions remain approximate.

before.label: Upper dark masonry shell
before.notes: Photo shows upper dark masonry. Shared footprint, roof and floor height are provisional. Interior is an undivided inferred space; windows and upper silhouette remain pending.

after.label: Upper dark masonry shell
after.notes: Upper dark masonry, two front openings and a side window are photo-observed. Current editable upper shell has those openings and return-stair access. Shared footprint, floor height, flat roof and undivided upper interior remain inferred; the image crops the roofline.

before.label: Four stools and concrete blocks
before.notes: Four stools and blocks observed. Provisional grey paving now follows the clipped building corner. Brick texture and curb elevations remain pending. Canopy belongs to exterior stair entry; glazed door is a single-leaf approximation.

after.label: Four stools and concrete blocks
after.notes: Four stools and side-perforated concrete blocks are observed. Current paving follows the clipped corner; raised curb, road and drainage remain absent. A two-cell canopy covers the glazed double-leaf stair entrance. Furniture dimensions and paving pattern remain approximate.

before.label: White open-door symbol on blue corner panel
before.notes: Photo-observed painted door symbol recreated as a reusable attached graphic. Position and proportions approximate; not a functional door.

after.label: White open-door symbol on blue corner panel
after.notes: Photo-observed painted door symbol recreated as a reusable attached graphic. Position and proportions approximate; not a functional door.

before.label: Rear pendant
before.notes: Second suspended cone shade. Distinct from the small wall-mounted light further back, which is still missing. Placement provisional.

after.label: Rear pendant
after.notes: Second suspended cone shade, distinct from the implemented small bracket-mounted rear wall lamp. Both fixture types exist and are switchable. Exact location, scale and hanging height remain provisional.

before.label: Raised dark door
before.notes: Observed dark leaf and raised step beside the bar. Reusable editable threshold is now present and traversable; chosen height/depth are provisional, not measured from the photo. Grid location and hidden rear strip remain inferred; hidden room function unknown.

after.label: Raised dark door
after.notes: Observed dark leaf and raised step beside the bar. The architect plan identifies the enclosed area as a bathroom. Editable threshold and bathroom route have been traversed; height, depth, finishes and hidden fixture appearance remain approximations.

before.label: Brown wall panel
before.notes: Observed broad brown wall surface beside the dark door. Linked first of two contiguous umber plaster wall segments. Position/proportion inferred; conduit and exact panel width remain unresolved.

after.label: Brown wall panel
after.notes: Observed broad brown wall surface beside the bathroom door. Linked first of two umber-plaster segments; twin overhead conduit and end riser are now present. Exact width, surface weathering and spatial proportions remain approximate.

before.label: Return staircase — approximate geometry
before.notes: Generic 3x2 left-return stair added through the workshop. Actual browser ascent to floor1 and descent to ground verified. Tread dimensions/material are approximations; upper destination is provisional roof/landing, not a reconstructed upper building. Guards and visibility from above remain incomplete.

after.label: Return staircase — approximate geometry
after.notes: Editable 3x2 left-return staircase connects ground to an upper room. Actual ascent/descent and upper-view shaft visibility have been verified; guards are present. Stair dimensions, material and upper interior are inferred rather than metrically reconstructed.
